Compiler warning at author severity from Recommended
Spacing around binary operators is pure layout the formatter fixes; no behaviour changes, so a gate from Strict only.
A stray space after a unary operator is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.
Spacing after NOT is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.
BEGIN..END around a single statement is clutter, not a defect; style gated from Strict.
Parentheses on parameterless calls tell a call from a field or variable at a glance; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Placement of BEGIN after THEN, ELSE or DO is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.
Control keywords that do not start a line are layout only and the formatter fixes them; a gate from Strict only.
Ordering declarations by type is a house style with no effect on behaviour and many hits in old code; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Rewriting IF ELSE chains as CASE is a readability opinion; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Nested WITH makes it unclear which record a name binds to and can bind the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Granting permissions on another app's objects from a permission set extension breaks when that app changes and widens access silently; Warning from Recommended.
Pulling another app's permission sets into an extension couples to permissions you do not own and widens access; Warning from Recommended.
Including sets that carry permissions on another app's objects widens access through a set you do not control; Warning from Recommended.
A wildcard in a permission set extension grants every object to everyone holding the base set; Warning from Essential as a security rule.
Opt-in naming rule that suffixes names with their type; an opinion many codebases reject, Info in Complete only.
A temporary record without the Temp prefix invites DeleteAll or Modify on what a reader thinks is real data; Warning from Recommended.
Approved label suffixes (Msg, Err, Qst, Tok, Lbl) show how a text is used; naming advice, a gate from Strict.
The lower-permissions test library declared outside a test codeunit drags test tooling into production code; Warning from Recommended.
Quoted identifiers make code harder to read and search; naming advice, a gate from Strict.
API page property values are a public contract that cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
API page field names are the JSON contract and cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
API query property values are a public contract that cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
API query column names are the JSON contract and cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.
A page part that embeds its own parent page recurses and fails when the page opens; Error everywhere.
An API page that uses the same subpage twice fails when the API is called; Error everywhere.
Arguments that do not match the placeholders leave raw %1 text or drop values in user messages; Warning from Recommended.
Unreachable code usually means a misplaced exit or condition, a likely bug; Warning from Recommended.
An unused variable is dead weight that hides typos; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Assigning longer text to a shorter target overflows at runtime once the value is long enough; Warning from Recommended.
A var parameter that is never written misleads callers about side effects; advisory, a gate from Strict.
AssertError belongs to the test runner; outside a test codeunit it signals test logic in production code; Warning from Recommended.
Finding a record whose values are never used costs a database round trip for nothing; performance, Warning from Recommended.
FindSet or Find without Next fetches a result set that is never iterated; performance, Warning from Recommended.
An invalid ApplicationArea value hides the control from users; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
An action with no trigger and no run object shows a button that does nothing; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A local that shadows a global makes it easy to read or write the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.
The order of ApplicationArea values has no effect; consistency only, Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Values listed next to All are redundant and suggest a misunderstanding of the setting; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Basic without Suite can hide the control in experiences that enable Suite only; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A local named like a field, method or action shadows it and code silently uses the local; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A method named like a field or action makes calls and field access ambiguous to readers; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A global named like a field, method or action shadows it across the object; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Reading a variable before any assignment relies on a default value and often hides a missing initialisation; Warning from Recommended.
A value assigned and never read is a dead store that can hide a lost result; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A non-local event subscriber becomes callable API surface that cannot be changed later; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.
Filtering on fields without a supporting key scans tables; a performance hint with false positives, advisory, a gate from Strict.
CalcFields on a field that is neither a FlowField nor a Blob throws a runtime error when it runs; Error everywhere.
An obsolete marking without state or reason either does not obsolete at all or leaves consumers no guidance; Warning from Recommended.
Modify on a record that was not changed costs a write for nothing or reveals a missing assignment; Warning from Recommended.
File naming conventions help navigation but renaming old files is churn; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.
Concatenated user messages cannot be translated as a whole; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
A literal format string in StrSubstNo cannot be translated; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
Page fields and actions without a tooltip leave users without in-product help; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Opt-in wording rule for tooltips starting with Specifies; style, Info in Complete only.
An empty tooltip shows users a blank help bubble; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
Option controls without OptionCaption show untranslated raw option names; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
SIFT on a primary or unique key maintains totals over single rows, a write cost with no benefit; performance, Warning from Recommended.
An empty OptionCaption shows users blank option values; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A caption count that differs from the options shows users wrong or missing values; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
Page fields without a caption fall back to the source name and may not translate; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.
An empty caption shows users a field without a label; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
An unchecked Get or Find in an upgrade codeunit throws when data is missing and aborts the tenant upgrade; Warning from Essential as a deployment risk.
An unused local method is dead code to maintain; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Pinning a version on a platform assembly breaks the reference when the platform updates; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
StrSubstNo or concatenation inside Error hides the label from telemetry and translation; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A FlowField without a supporting SIFT key computes by scanning; a performance hint, advisory, a gate from Strict.
Next after Get, FindFirst or FindLast loops on a single-row fetch and reads row by row; performance and likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Opt-in rule for tooltips on table fields; useful but noisy in older code, Info in Complete only.
Per-company install code without a company-initialise subscriber leaves companies created later unconfigured; a real defect, raised to Warning from Recommended.
A real record named Temp invites DeleteAll on what a reader thinks is a buffer, risking data loss; Warning from Recommended.
E-mail addresses and phone numbers in source leak personal data into the repository and the app; Warning from Recommended given test-data false positives.
Lowercase keywords are style; Hidden keeps the code action available, visible from Strict.
Reading a field not in SetLoadFields triggers an extra JIT load per record; performance, Warning from Recommended.
Running a codeunit of subtype Upgrade throws a runtime error; Error everywhere.
A parameter named like a global shadows it so the body may use the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A parameter named like a field, method or action shadows it within the method; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A pragma that disables every diagnostic hides real errors and future warnings; Warning from Recommended.
Namespaces avoid name clashes and are the platform direction; advisory while code migrates, a gate from Strict.
The this qualifier is a readability preference; Hidden keeps the code action available, visible from Strict.

Only signal that a PlatformCop analyzer crashed and its checks did not run; always visible, never blocking.

Passing a field that is neither FlowField nor Blob to SetAutoCalcFields raises a runtime error; Error everywhere.
With wildcard or case operators SetFilter leaves the placeholder unsubstituted and returns the wrong records; Error everywhere.
A subscriber without var gets a copy, so its changes never reach the publisher; often harmless for a read only subscriber, Warning from Recommended.
A handled flag passed by value can never be raised by subscribers, so the IsHandled pattern is broken for every extender; Warning from Essential.
Assigning a FlowFilter field sets no filter, so CalcFields sums every record; a silent wrong result, Warning from Essential.
Get arguments that do not match the primary key fetch the wrong record or fail with a type error at runtime; Error everywhere.
Double quotes in a JPath make SelectToken silently return nothing; a definite wrong result, Warning from Essential.
Comparing a Guid with an empty string fails to parse and throws at runtime; Error everywhere.
Clear or ClearAll leaves a SingleInstance codeunit's state intact, so an intended reset silently does nothing; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A record that does not match the page's source table fails with a conversion error when the page or lookup runs; Error everywhere.
Record methods on a page without a source table have no buffer, so the page opens without the passed record; Error everywhere.
The not-empty filter escaped with three quotes filters on a single quote instead of empty; a silent wrong result, Warning from Essential.
TransferFields between fields of one id with incompatible types throws at runtime, also in base app posting; Error everywhere.
Same field id under different names across a TransferFields pair copies values into the wrong field; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Text that may exceed the target length through Validate, SetFilter, Get or a translated label throws at runtime; Warning from Recommended like AA0139.
A subscriber that can lower the handled flag undoes an earlier subscriber's decision; an extensibility bug, Warning from Recommended.
ApplicationArea on an API page is ignored and only adds noise; cleanup advice, a gate from Strict.
A business key in ODataKeyFields breaks Power Automate and stored links, and changing it after release breaks consumers; Warning from Essential.
An API page without id and lastModifiedDateTime lacks a stable identifier and silently loses webhooks; Warning from Recommended.
Running table triggers on a temporary record can write to the database through trigger code; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
A field shorter than the field it relates to truncates looked up values and fails validation; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Random GUIDs in key fields fragment the SQL index and slow inserts; performance advice, a gate from Strict.
Reads without SetLoadFields fetch every column; performance advice that fires on most reads, a gate from Strict.
Partial records before a full-record write force a JIT load that costs a roundtrip and can fail under concurrency; Warning from Recommended.
A layout Caption or Summary over 250 characters makes the Report Layout Selection page fail at runtime; Error everywhere.
Control names that collide after the OData name mapping make Edit in Excel and OData calls fail; Warning from Essential.
A placeholder without a matching argument shows a literal placeholder to the user; a user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended like AA0131.
CalcFields inside a loop issues one query per row and FlowField; a performance defect, Warning from Recommended.
SetRecord does not accept a temporary record and raises a runtime error; Error everywhere.
Direct field assignment skips OnValidate and its subscribers, but fires on most assignments and is often deliberate; advice from Strict, a gate in Complete.
A path that falls through returns an implicit default and can hide a logic bug; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Reports that an analyzer crashed, not a defect in the code; always visible, never blocking.
A list page source table without lookup and drill-down pages leaves users no way to open the record from a field value; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A blank single-field key lets a later delete or rename cascade into every unrelated record with an empty relation field; data-loss risk, Warning from Recommended.
NotBlank on a key filled by a number series rejects every new record in the client before OnInsert runs; Warning from Essential since detection is heuristic.
A direct Confirm call fails at runtime in job queues and web service calls where no UI exists; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Switching the session language by hand risks leaving it switched when the restore is missed or an error interrupts; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Hardcoding the page for document and setup tables opens the wrong variant, for example a quote on the order page; Warning from Recommended.
A public install or upgrade codeunit invites other apps to call it, so later cleanup becomes a breaking change; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.
Opt-in check that records the per-company storage choice explicitly, since changing it later needs empty tables; Info in Complete only.
A permission set caption without a length cap lets translations exceed 30 characters and get truncated in the list; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Objects outside every permission set force administrators to grant access by hand before users can work; Warning from Recommended.
Without a caption a user-facing element gets no translation unit and shows the AL identifier in every language; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An integration event in an internal codeunit cannot be subscribed to from other apps, so the extension point is dead; Warning from Recommended.
Opt-in check for DropDown and Brick field groups so lookups and tiles show useful fields; Info in Complete only.
Tooltip text without closing punctuation is a style lapse against the user assistance guidelines; too cosmetic to advise, a gate from Strict.
Field tooltips that do not open with Specifies break the wording convention of the standard application; style, a gate from Strict.
A line break escape in a tooltip renders as a literal backslash in the client; visible defect, Warning from Recommended.
Tooltips over 200 characters turn a quick hint into a block of text users must read; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An unlocked empty caption adds a blank translation unit that translators must skip in every language; translation hygiene, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A meaningful value at ordinal zero cannot be told apart from the default every new record gets; design advice, a gate from Strict.
A token label left translatable can be translated and break the API key or identifier it carries; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.
Opt-in naming check that marks every locked label as a token; Info in Complete only.
A caption on the empty enum value is dead metadata the platform ignores; harmless clutter, advisory then a gate from Strict.
An enum value with an empty caption cannot be picked in dropdowns; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.
A public event publisher freezes its signature as public API while subscribers need no public access; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.
Assigning the magic number 10 for a line feed hides intent that the Type Helper separators state; readability, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A field kept off every page can still be added and edited through page customization unless its exposure is set; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A locked label whose text equals its name is a token and should say so with its suffix; naming refinement, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A tooltip kept on the page instead of the table field must be copied to every page and goes stale; maintainability, a gate from Strict.
A page tooltip that repeats the table field tooltip stops following later table edits; maintainability, advisory then a gate from Strict.
A discarded Get or Find result raises only the generic platform error, often deliberately; noisy advice, Info from Strict.
Table access without declared object permissions fails for users who hold only indirect permissions; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Declared permissions the code never uses mislead anyone auditing what the object touches; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Advice that the app ships its own Rest Client handler so its own HTTP setting governs its calls; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.
Advice that the app carries its own Telemetry Logger instead of relying on another app of the publisher; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.
Only signal that a LinterCop analyzer crashed and checked nothing; always visible, never blocking.
A numeric object id compiles silently when the object is renumbered or renamed, hiding drift a name would catch; Warning from Recommended.
Reports a maintainability score, not a defect; Info in Complete only.
A low maintainability score marks code that is costly to change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Reports a cyclomatic complexity number, not a defect; Info in Complete only.
Too many execution paths make a procedure hard to test and change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A field repeating the table data classification keeps the old value when the table changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A control repeating the page application area keeps the old value when the page changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.
String literals in subscriber arguments break go to definition and references; advisory, a gate from Strict.
LockTable widens locks to every read of the table and disables optimistic reads; advisory because the fix is not mechanical, a gate from Strict.
A runtime behind the target only withholds newer language features and is often kept low on purpose for older servers; Info from Recommended.
A bare Insert, Modify or Delete hides whether skipping triggers was intended; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Credential held in Text is readable in the debugger and snapshot sessions; Warning from Essential as a security rule.
Error with plain Text replaces the message in telemetry with a placeholder, so failures cannot be diagnosed; Warning from Recommended.
An internal procedure nobody calls is dead code or a missing call; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An internal procedure used only in its own object exposes more scope than it needs; advisory, a gate from Strict.
The interface prefix contradicts the mandatory AppSource affixes and is opinion elsewhere; None everywhere.
Non-canonical API field names force consumers to map fields, but renaming a published field breaks integrations; Info until Complete.
Comparing Count with zero scans every matching row where IsEmpty reads one; a performance fix from Recommended.
Count equal to one scans every matching row where Find and Next read two; advisory since the rewrite needs judgment, a gate from Strict.
Numeric-argument date functions and Format round-trips obscure which part is read; readability advice, a gate from Strict.
A misspelled style string compiles and silently drops the styling the user should see; Warning from Recommended.
Option values cannot be extended by other apps and invite magic numbers; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Reports a cognitive complexity number, not a defect; Info in Complete only.
One message per complexity increment is noise next to the metric and the threshold rule; None everywhere.
Deep nesting makes a procedure hard to read and easy to break three levels down; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A missing or unfinished translation shows source-language text to users in that locale; Warning from Recommended, silent without XLIFF files.
Inconsistent identifier naming makes symbol search unreliable and slows review; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A field repeating the object AllowInCustomizations value is redundant noise; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An unused parameter clutters the signature, but removing one from a public procedure breaks dependent apps; Info until Complete.
Passing a record to a method already called on it misleads readers about what the method needs; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Mixing exit and named return assignments is a style choice of an opt-in rule; Info in Complete only.
A subscriber name that does not encode source and event hides what it reacts to; advisory, a gate from Strict.
An unused subscriber parameter clutters the signature and is safe to drop; advisory, a gate from Strict.
The only sign that the documentation analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.
A manual commit without a reason invites a later refactor to remove or copy it blindly; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A write to a calculated field is not stored and looks like a bug unless a comment says why; advisory, a gate from Strict.
A stray semicolon is either leftover code or an undocumented no-op; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Public procedures without XML docs leave callers guessing in IntelliSense; too noisy for most projects below Strict.
XML docs that name missing parameters mislead callers in signature help; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Opt-in documentation for internal procedures; Info in Complete only.
Public objects without XML docs leave consumers without a stated purpose; too noisy for most projects below Strict.
Opt-in documentation for internal objects; Info in Complete only.
Published events without XML docs leave subscribers guessing at when they fire; too noisy for most projects below Strict.
Opt-in documentation for internal events; Info in Complete only.
The only sign that the formatting analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.
A semicolon after a procedure header is harmless style noise; advisory below the author default, a gate from Strict.
Casing that differs from the declaration is pure style with a code fix; floods legacy code, so a gate from Strict.
A call without parentheses reads like a property access; style below the author default, a gate from Strict.
Unsorted permission entries cause avoidable merge conflicts and a code fix sorts them; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Assignment syntax hides that a method runs; style below the author default, a gate from Strict.
Uppercase permission letters wrongly suggest a direct grant but change nothing at runtime; opinion, Warning in Complete.
Blank lines between statement blocks are an opt-in layout preference; Info in Complete only.
The only sign that the test automation analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.
A global procedure in a test codeunit is either a missed test attribute or a misplaced helper; advisory, a gate from Strict.
Invoking an action on a part opened on its own fails the test at runtime; Error from Recommended as only test code is hit.
